actual_scope: Assumption ID native_all_columns, selected #5599 word: do all 2,887 distinct paid chart changes, the 540 helper normalizer pairs and the 208 main adapters equal their compiler-lowered recipes (Gaussian monomial, rank-r Fourier child, Gaussian monomial) as exact operators with absolute phase, with child rank equal to the paid rank of the invoice, and is every monomial factor a fixed f-independent record list, so that the whole native layer of this word lifts to every column multiplicity f >= 1 by the #5442 lemma?
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one assumption ID, one quantified implication and the actual caller. #5837 proved the scalar instructions of this word lift; #5894 traced the author's own MOVE checker and replayed one of 2,887 pairs, asking for independent verification of the existing coverage and for the physical realization. This package supplies the complete independent algebraic certificate for the current caller by a different method (dense exact matrices, no tableau or sparse state), binds the certified recipes to the author's registered payload hash, and ports the #5445 record-level realization of the monomial factors to this word. The tariff of the records, spectators and whole-job adapters, and the other four assumptions, stay open.
bottleneck_link: Side result; no new kappa. It closes the algebraic half of native_all_columns for the binding complex word with independent coverage and reduces its physical half to the retained record primitives plus rank-r children; admitted BIT and the other four framework assumptions still block an unconditional exponent.
stop_rule: Stop when every distinct chart change, helper pair and adapter of the selected word is certified densely and every monomial factor is realized as records, or at the first operator whose dense matrix differs from its recipe. Do not rerun frontier5599-verify, do not simulate the compact-control rotation scheme, do not re-derive the tariff.
evidence: PROOF.md (dense equality, support rank, factorwise tensor lift, record lemma); verify.py builds all 1,089 canonical charts as dense unitary matrices, certifies 2,923 distinct chart changes (2,887 MOVE pairs plus helper pairs) and 208 adapters entrywise with absolute phase, checks rank = paid rank, binds the recipe payload to the author's RESULT.json hash, shows the factorwise lift of the first MOVE at widths 2 and 3 against the failing termwise lift, and executes the record lists of every distinct monomial factor; RESULT.json is frozen; test_verify.py has rejecting controls.
